meaning:
θυμίαμα, -τος, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת ;]
fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., Luk.1:10; θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ. (Exo.30:27, al.), Luk.1:11; pl., Rev.5:8 8:3-4 18:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full…
